policies.title: Covered preventive and imaging services
policies.clause_text: Payer A covers medically necessary outpatient imaging including G0202 and related follow-up visits when ordered by a treating provider.

policies.title: Prior authorization
policies.clause_text: Prior authorization is required for annual wellness visit code G0439. Claims without a prior-auth ID may be denied as CO-16.

policies.title: Imaging coverage
policies.clause_text: Outpatient imaging above two thousand dollars is covered when medically necessary and not subject to automatic denial solely on charge amount.

policies.title: Follow-up visits
policies.clause_text: Covered follow-up evaluation and management visits after an imaging study are payable under this policy.

policies.title: Filing deadline
policies.clause_text: Claims must be filed within 90 days of the date of service unless the member is entitled to an extension under state law.

adjudications.denial_text: CO-50 not medically necessary imaging auto denial bulk pattern
